verdict.rationale: A probe found an official Raygun MCP server published under MindscapeHQ, Raygun's parent organization, at github.com/MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun, so the core story of connecting an agent through an official MCP server is delivered. The evidence is only a single pointer with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of exposed tools and capabilities, setup and authentication details, supported transports/clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
